content: US District Judge Loren AliKhan has blocked the Federal Communications Commission from conducting an early review of ABC’s broadcast licenses in a preliminary injunction, and rejected its efforts to dismiss ABC’s First Amendment lawsuit. ABC has accused the FCC of violating its free speech rights and claims the agency “waged a retaliatory campaign” against the network over content it broadcast. In her ruling the judge noted that the network was “likely to succeed on their retaliation claim.” Although Disney, ABC’s parent company, wasn’t set to renew its broadcast licenses until 2028, last April the FCC ordered the network to file for an early license renewal claiming it was part of an investigation into Disney’s policies on diversity, equity, and inclusivity. The FCC’s move came a day after President Donald Trump demanded ABC fire late-night talk show host Jimmy Kimmel following a skit about Melania Trump. In response to the FCC’s order, Disney and ABC sued the agency in August and accused the FCC of “punishing ABC for its speech” by threatening its broadcast licenses. The preliminary injunction issued by the judge on Wednesday prohibits the FCC from taking any further action in the early review of ABC’s broadcast licenses and noted that the network had shown that the court’s intervention in the agency’s actions was in the public interest. ”No one doubts that the Commission may enforce the law in the manner it sees fit,” the judge wrote. “But in doing so, Defendants may not retaliate against or punish Plaintiffs and other broadcast license holders for disfavored speech.”
chineseTitle: 联邦法官阻止 FCC 提前审查 ABC 的许可证

chineseContent: 美国地区法官 Loren AliKhan 在初步禁令中阻止联邦通信委员会对 ABC 的广播许可证进行早期审查，并拒绝其驳回 ABC 第一修正案诉讼的努力。美国广播公司 (ABC) 指责美国联邦通信委员会 (FCC) 侵犯其言论自由权，并声称该机构针对该网络播放的内容“发起了报复行动”。法官在裁决中指出，该网络“很可能成功实现其报复主张”。尽管 ABC 的母公司迪士尼要到 2028 年才会续签其广播许可证，但去年 4 月，美国联邦通信委员会 (FCC) 命令该网络提前申请续签许可证，声称这是对迪士尼多样性、公平和包容性政策调查的一部分。 FCC 采取这一举措的前一天，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普 (Donald Trump) 在播出有关梅拉尼娅·特朗普 (Melania Trump) 的短剧后，要求美国广播公司 (ABC) 解雇深夜脱口秀节目主持人吉米·金梅尔 (Jimmy Kimmel)。为了回应 FCC 的命令，迪士尼和 ABC 在 8 月对该机构提起诉讼，并指责 FCC 通过威胁其广播许可证来“惩罚 ABC 的言论”。法官周三发布的初步禁令禁止 FCC 在对 ABC 广播许可证的早期审查中采取任何进一步行动，并指出该网络已表明法院对该机构行动的干预符合公共利益。 “没有人怀疑委员会可以以其认为合适的方式执行法律，”法官写道。 “但在此过程中，被告不得因不受欢迎的言论而对原告和其他广播许可证持有者进行报复或惩罚。”
